nodes.name: install.sh
nodes.summary: Bash installer for macOS/Linux: re-execs under /bin/bash, detects OS, provisions a supported Node (brew node 26 on macOS, LTS 24 on Linux, user-space runtime on unsafe-SQLite RPM), runs `npm install -g openclaw`, persists PATH into shell rc files, and chains into `openclaw onboard`.

nodes.name: daemon-cli/install.ts
nodes.summary: Implements `openclaw gateway install`: merges safe invocation env, resolves/validates the runtime pin, blocks no-auth non-loopback installs, defaults gateway.mode=local, resolves a token, and installs the managed service via service.install.

nodes.name: daemon-cli/lifecycle.ts
nodes.summary: Gateway service lifecycle runners (runDaemonStart/Stop/Restart) including unmanaged-listener fallbacks, launchd recovery, service-definition repair, and restart health checks.

nodes.name: register-service-commands.ts
nodes.summary: Commander registration for gateway/daemon subcommands status/install/uninstall/start/stop/restart with shared flags (--json, --force, --port, --runtime, --wrapper, stop --disable).

nodes.name: start-repair.ts
nodes.summary: Rebuilds a stale managed Gateway service definition before start/restart; refuses repair when the invoking shell's state dir/config/port differ from the installed service and when an operator drop-in overrides the command.

nodes.name: launchd-recovery.ts
nodes.summary: Re-bootstraps an installed-but-unloaded Gateway LaunchAgent after a daemon start/restart command.

nodes.name: launchd-plist.ts
nodes.summary: Builds launchd LaunchAgent plist XML and the LAUNCH_AGENT_POLICY (RunAtLoad/KeepAlive/ExitTimeOut/ProcessType/ThrottleInterval/Umask/StandardInPath); reads env-wrapper ProgramArguments layouts and renders EnvironmentVariables.

nodes.name: launchd-install.ts
nodes.summary: Transactional LaunchAgent install/stage/uninstall: captures original plist/env/wrapper bytes, refuses mutation from inside the service or over a system LaunchDaemon, bootstraps, and rolls back on failure; uninstall moves the plist to ~/.Trash.

nodes.name: launchd-runtime.ts
nodes.summary: Observes and activates LaunchAgents: parses `launchctl print`, probes loaded/running state, resolves the gui/<uid> domain, and bootstraps/enables/kickstarts with pending-teardown retry and GUI-session diagnostics.

nodes.name: launchd-service-files.ts
nodes.summary: Publishes the LaunchAgent plist plus the owner-only (0600) generated env file and (0700) /bin/sh env wrapper under <state>/service-env; provides transactional capture/restore of plist+env+wrapper.

nodes.name: launchd-restart-handoff.ts
nodes.summary: Detached macOS restart handoff: spawns a detached /bin/sh that waits for the caller PID, re-checks system-daemon ownership, then bootout+bootstrap (reload) or kickstart -k/bootstrap (kickstart) to safely respawn the Gateway.

nodes.name: launchd-stop.ts
nodes.summary: Stops a LaunchAgent via launchctl bootout, waits out the exit-timeout/port-release budget, and verifies the job is no longer running.

nodes.name: launchd-system.ts
nodes.summary: Refuses LaunchAgent mutation when the same label is owned by a system LaunchDaemon in /Library/LaunchDaemons; provides a package-independent shell ownership probe for detached helpers.

nodes.name: launchd-label.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves and validates the effective launchd label (OPENCLAW_LAUNCHD_LABEL override or profile-derived ai.openclaw.gateway).

nodes.name: launchd-foreign-jobs.ts
nodes.summary: Scans ai.openclaw.* launchd jobs that are not the current gateway/node ownership, classifying KeepAlive and literal straight-line `openclaw gateway restart|start|stop` invocations as safeToRemove.

nodes.name: constants.ts
nodes.summary: Cross-platform daemon service names and labels: ai.openclaw.gateway/ai.openclaw.node, profile suffixes, selector env keys, and legacy systemd service names.

nodes.name: paths.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves the daemon home and Gateway state dir ($OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR else ~/.openclaw with profile suffix) and the Windows task script path.

nodes.name: restart-logs.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves Gateway log paths (state-dir logs/gateway.log) and launchd supervisor log paths (~/Library/Logs/openclaw/gateway[-profile].log); appends best-effort lifecycle audit lines.

nodes.name: doctor-foreign-launchd-jobs.ts
nodes.summary: Doctor note+repair for foreign ai.openclaw.* launchd jobs on macOS; removal only with --fix, default install identity, and allowed service repair.

nodes.name: doctor-gateway-daemon-flow.ts
nodes.summary: Doctor flow that diagnoses the local Gateway service: port conflicts, service inspection failures, install owner, and supervision restart when policy allows.

nodes.name: doctor-gateway-services.ts
nodes.summary: Doctor service checks: recorded runtime/heap inspection, system Node availability (SUPPORTED_NODE_VERSIONS), definition drift, and install-owner reporting.

nodes.name: doctor-gateway-legacy-services.ts
nodes.summary: Classifies and cleans legacy Gateway user services (darwin user services, known legacy systemd unit names such as clawdbot-gateway), removing only recognized units.

nodes.name: uninstall.ts
nodes.summary: `openclaw uninstall`: scopes service|state|workspace|app (--all/--dry-run/--yes); stops the gateway before removing state, preserves workspaces for state-only, and removes the macOS app.

nodes.name: gateway-readiness.ts
nodes.summary: Ensures the dashboard Gateway is ready: gathers daemon status, decides install-vs-start, calls runDaemonInstall/runDaemonStart, then polls for a healthy listener.

nodes.name: onboard.ts
nodes.summary: `openclaw onboard`/setup entry: normalizes legacy auth flags, validates project options, and routes between guided, classic interactive, and non-interactive setup flows.

nodes.name: onboard-non-interactive.ts
nodes.summary: Non-interactive onboarding driver: leases core:onboarding state, rejects prompts, and runs local/remote/migration-import setup exclusively.

nodes.name: onboard-types.ts
nodes.summary: OnboardOptions type surface including installDaemon/daemonRuntime flags consumed by the wizard finalize step.

nodes.name: register.onboard.ts
nodes.summary: Commander registration for onboard/setup: auth/gateway/remote/runtime options, --install-daemon/--no-install-daemon/--skip-daemon precedence, and OnboardOptions resolution.

nodes.name: setup.finalize.ts
nodes.summary: Wizard finalize: ensureGatewayServiceForOnboarding decides whether to install the Gateway service (explicit flag, Linux systemd availability, quickstart default, prompt) and installs/resumes it.

nodes.name: update-channels.ts
nodes.summary: Update channel model: stable/extended-stable/beta/dev, npm dist-tag mapping, effective channel resolution from config/git/installed version, and beta/stable version selection.

nodes.name: update-startup.ts
nodes.summary: Startup update scheduler: honors update.checkOnStart/auto.enabled and OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE, resolves the effective channel, and only auto-applies on stable/beta/dev when not externally supervised.

nodes.name: update-command-launch-agent-recovery.ts
nodes.summary: After an update, recovers an installed-but-not-loaded Gateway LaunchAgent by triggering bootstrap/kickstart recovery.

nodes.name: config/paths.ts
nodes.summary: Config path resolution: config filename openclaw.json, default ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json (or $OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR), state-dir and temp paths.

nodes.name: onboard-guided.ts
nodes.summary: Guided onboarding flow that chooses quickstart/advanced, gates inference, and forwards installDaemon=false for quickstart or skipped-inference runs.

nodes.name: daemon-cli/response.ts
nodes.summary: Shared daemon action context and installDaemonServiceAndEmit helper used by gateway install/onboard to emit service snapshots and success.

nodes.name: service-update-authority.ts
nodes.summary: Fences service mutations during an update: assertGatewayServiceUpdateCurrent / isUpdateOwnedGatewayServiceCommand / withGatewayServiceInstallationRecovery.

nodes.name: ports-format.ts
nodes.summary: Formats port diagnostics and decides whether listeners are expected Gateway listeners (used to distinguish a healthy Gateway from a port conflict).

nodes.name: install_node
nodes.summary: Installs a supported Node: brew install node on macOS (default major 26), distro packages/build tools on Linux, or a user-space runtime via install-cli.sh for unsafe-SQLite RPM hosts.

nodes.name: check_node
nodes.summary: Reuses a supported Node when present, otherwise reports that Node will be installed; validates version and SQLite capability.

nodes.name: persist_shell_path_prepend
nodes.summary: Persists an idempotent `export PATH=...` line into the detected shell rc files (.zshrc/.zprofile/.bashrc/.bash_profile/fish conf.d) with symlink and ownership guards.

nodes.name: run_npm_global_install
nodes.summary: Builds an explicit `npm install -g` argv (strips before/min-release-age config), runs it with spinner, and verifies lifecycle scripts completed.

nodes.name: buildLaunchAgentPlist
nodes.summary: Renders the LaunchAgent plist XML from label, ProgramArguments, WorkingDirectory, StandardOut/ErrorPath, EnvironmentVariables, and LAUNCH_AGENT_POLICY.

nodes.name: installLaunchAgent
nodes.summary: Transactionally installs/captures the LaunchAgent, re-checks system-daemon ownership, bootstraps it, and restores the previous definition on failure.

nodes.name: uninstallLaunchAgent
nodes.summary: Boots out the LaunchAgent and moves its plist to ~/.Trash; refuses mutation from inside the service.

nodes.name: bootstrapLaunchAgentOrThrow
nodes.summary: Enables and bootstraps gui/<uid>/<label>, retrying EIO pending-teardown within the ExitTimeOut budget and reporting GUI-session errors for headless/SSH contexts.

nodes.name: resolveLaunchAgentGuiDomain
nodes.summary: Returns gui/<uid> (or gui/501 fallback) for LaunchAgent activation.

nodes.name: probeLaunchAgentState
nodes.summary: Runs `launchctl print <target>` and classifies running/stopped/not-loaded/unknown so callers apply one absence-vs-failure policy.

nodes.name: parseLaunchctlJob
nodes.summary: Parses the selected job's state/pid/last exit/arguments/environment from launchctl print output.

nodes.name: resolveLaunchAgentLabel
nodes.summary: Validates and returns OPENCLAW_LAUNCHD_LABEL or the profile-derived ai.openclaw.gateway label.

nodes.name: writeLaunchAgentPlist
nodes.summary: Prepares the env file+wrapper, builds the plist, and publishes it (plus preserved operator policy) transactionally.

nodes.name: buildLaunchAgentEnvironmentWrapper
nodes.summary: Returns the /bin/sh wrapper that validates the env-file header and execs the Gateway command with that environment.

nodes.name: resolveLaunchAgentPlistPath
nodes.summary: Returns ~/Library/LaunchAgents/<label>.plist for the user.

nodes.name: scheduleDetachedLaunchdRestartHandoff
nodes.summary: Spawns a detached /bin/sh that waits for the caller PID, guards system-daemon ownership, then reloads or kickstarts the LaunchAgent.

nodes.name: findForeignLaunchdJobs
nodes.summary: Enumerates ai.openclaw.* jobs not owned by the current gateway/node profile and classifies KeepAlive/lifecycle invocations.

nodes.name: resolveGatewayLaunchAgentLabel
nodes.summary: Returns ai.openclaw.gateway for the default profile or ai.openclaw.<profile> for a named profile.

nodes.name: resolveGatewayStateDir
nodes.summary: Resolves $OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR or ~/.openclaw with the -<profile> suffix; the historical default state path.

nodes.name: resolveGatewayLogPaths
nodes.summary: Resolves <state>/logs/gateway.log and gateway.err.log for CLI-side logging.

nodes.name: resolveGatewaySupervisorLogPaths
nodes.summary: Resolves ~/Library/Logs/openclaw/gateway[-profile].log used as launchd stdout/stderr.

nodes.name: noteMacForeignLaunchdJobs
nodes.summary: Reports foreign ai.openclaw.* launchd jobs to Doctor and removes confirmed stray lifecycle jobs only with repair enabled and default install identity.

nodes.name: noteGatewayPortDiagnostics
nodes.summary: Reports a Gateway port as conflicting when it is busy but not held by expected Gateway listeners.

nodes.name: classifyLegacyServices
nodes.summary: Splits detected legacy services into darwin/linux user services and failures, matching known legacy systemd unit names.

nodes.name: uninstallCommand
nodes.summary: Executes scoped uninstall (service/state/workspace/app): stops the gateway, removes state and optional workspaces/app, honoring --dry-run/--yes.

nodes.name: ensureDashboardGatewayReady
nodes.summary: Gathers daemon status and, when the gateway is stopped and recoverable, installs or starts the managed service then polls for readiness.

nodes.name: runDaemonInstall
nodes.summary: Installs/refreshes the managed Gateway service with env merging, runtime pin resolution, auth/bind guards, and token resolution.

nodes.name: mergeInstallInvocationEnv
nodes.summary: Merges safe existing service environment into the install invocation, preserving NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS and dropping TLS-disable/proxy/loader overrides.

nodes.name: runDaemonStart
nodes.summary: Starts the managed Gateway service, recovers an unloaded LaunchAgent, repairs a stale definition, and verifies start readiness.

nodes.name: runDaemonStop
nodes.summary: Stops the managed Gateway service or a verified unmanaged listener; requires --force non-interactively and supports --disable (launchd).

nodes.name: runDaemonRestart
nodes.summary: Restarts the managed service or a verified unmanaged listener and proves listener health before reporting success.

nodes.name: addGatewayServiceCommands
nodes.summary: Attaches status/install/uninstall/start/stop/restart subcommands and shared flags to the gateway (and legacy daemon) CLI.

nodes.name: repairLoadedGatewayServiceForStart
nodes.summary: Rebuilds a stale managed service definition for start/restart, refusing when the ambient state/config/port or an operator override diverges from the installed service.

nodes.name: ensureGatewayServiceForOnboarding
nodes.summary: Decides whether to install the Gateway service during onboarding and installs/resumes it, or skips for external supervision / no user systemd.

nodes.name: resolveEffectiveUpdateChannel
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective update channel and its source (config/git-tag/git-branch/installed-version/default).

nodes.name: channelToNpmTag
nodes.summary: Maps an update channel to its npm dist-tag (stable->latest, others to their own tag).

nodes.name: recoverInstalledLaunchAgentAfterUpdate
nodes.summary: Detects an installed-but-not-loaded LaunchAgent after an update and triggers bootstrap/kickstart recovery, reporting the outcome.

nodes.name: setupWizardCommand
nodes.summary: Normalizes onboard options and dispatches guided/classic/non-interactive setup.

nodes.name: launchagent
nodes.summary: Per-user macOS launchd service (plist in ~/Library/LaunchAgents) that owns the Gateway process, bootstrapped into the gui/<uid> domain.

nodes.name: keepalive
nodes.summary: launchd KeepAlive+RunAtLoad policy (with 10s ThrottleInterval) that respawns the Gateway after crashes and at login.

nodes.name: install-daemon
nodes.summary: Onboarding option deciding whether to install the managed Gateway service (--install-daemon / --no-install-daemon / --skip-daemon).

nodes.name: update-channel
nodes.summary: Release stream (stable/extended-stable/beta/dev) selecting npm dist-tags and auto-update eligibility.

nodes.name: check-on-start
nodes.summary: Gateway startup update check gated by update.checkOnStart / update.auto.enabled / OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE.

nodes.name: safe-respawn
nodes.summary: Restart pattern that detaches a helper, waits for the current process to exit, then re-activates the service to avoid self-kill and duplicate respawns.

nodes.name: service-authority
nodes.summary: Ownership/custody rules that fence service mutations: refuse from inside the service, over system daemons, or during an update.

nodes.name: state-dir
nodes.summary: Operator state root ~/.openclaw (or $OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR), holding config, logs, and service-env, profile-suffixed for named profiles.

nodes.name: foreign-launchd-jobs
nodes.summary: Stray ai.openclaw.* launchd jobs (often KeepAlive) that can restart the Gateway unexpectedly; detected by status/doctor.

nodes.name: port-conflict
nodes.summary: A Gateway port busy with unexpected listeners; distinguished from a healthy Gateway via probe evidence.

nodes.name: node-runtime-mismatch
nodes.summary: Recorded service Node being missing/unsupported relative to SUPPORTED_NODE_VERSIONS and SQLite capability checks.

nodes.name: onboarding-wizard
nodes.summary: Guided/classic/non-interactive onboarding that writes config and optionally installs the daemon.

nodes.name: path-persistence
nodes.summary: Installer rewriting shell rc files so the npm global bin (or ~/.local/bin) is on PATH for future shells.

nodes.name: uninstall-scopes
nodes.summary: service/state/workspace/app scopes for openclaw uninstall, with service teardown before local-data removal.

nodes.name: daemon-runtime-pin
nodes.summary: Recorded absolute Node/Bun executable pinned for the managed service, preserved across reinstall/update/repair.

nodes.name: env-wrapper
nodes.summary: Generated /bin/sh wrapper + 0600 env file that injects service environment outside inline plist XML.

nodes.name: openclaw.json
nodes.summary: Primary config file (default ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json, or $OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR/openclaw.json).

nodes.name: Gateway LaunchAgent plist
nodes.summary: Per-user launchd definition for the Gateway (RunAtLoad/KeepAlive/env wrapper).

nodes.name: Generated service env file
nodes.summary: Owner-only (0600) generated environment file loaded by the LaunchAgent env wrapper.

nodes.name: OpenClaw Gateway
nodes.summary: Always-on agent host process managed by launchd/systemd/Task Scheduler, exposing RPC/health and the Control UI.

nodes.name: ai.openclaw.gateway
nodes.summary: Default launchd label (ai.openclaw.<profile> for named profiles) identifying the managed Gateway job.

nodes.name: macos-lifecycle
nodes.summary: Umbrella flow: install -> onboard -> LaunchAgent install -> running gateway -> update/uninstall.

nodes.name: install
nodes.summary: curl install.sh: provision Node, npm install -g openclaw, persist PATH.

nodes.name: onboard
nodes.summary: openclaw onboard writes ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json and optionally requests daemon install.

nodes.name: launchagent-install
nodes.summary: runDaemonInstall builds and bootstraps the ai.openclaw.gateway LaunchAgent.

nodes.name: running-gateway
nodes.summary: Gateway serving under launchd with KeepAlive and health probes.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: openclaw update selects a channel, applies the package, and safely respawns the service.

nodes.name: Gateway service docs
nodes.summary: Operator reference for service lifecycle, runtime pinning, wrappers, heap sizing, and auth.

nodes.name: macOS gateway host docs
nodes.summary: Operator reference for macOS bundled runtime, LaunchAgent label/paths, hosting, foreign jobs, and logs.

nodes.name: Node.js docs
nodes.summary: Node version requirements, install options, PATH troubleshooting, startup recovery.

nodes.name: Release channels docs
nodes.summary: Stable/extended-stable/beta/dev semantics and switching via openclaw update --channel.

nodes.name: installDaemonServiceAndEmit
nodes.summary: Installs a daemon service and emits the JSON/text result, invoking install and onVerified callbacks.

nodes.name: assertGatewayServiceUpdateCurrent
nodes.summary: Throws when the service definition changed under a running update, fencing install/repair writes.

nodes.name: recoverInstalledLaunchAgent
nodes.summary: Re-bootstraps an installed but unloaded LaunchAgent and reports the recovery message.

nodes.name: formatPortDiagnostics
nodes.summary: Formats port diagnostics lines and identifies expected Gateway listeners to separate health from conflict.

nodes.summary: Tests Doctor foreign-launchd-job reporting/repair.

nodes.name: update-channels.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests update channel resolution and npm tag mapping.

nodes.name: launchd-plist.test-support.ts
nodes.summary: Test support fixtures for LaunchAgent plist building/reading.

nodes.name: install.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests gateway install env merge, pin, and guards.

nodes.name: lifecycle.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests gateway start/stop/restart runners.

nodes.summary: Tests doctor gateway service diagnostics.
